text_block_list.text:
“—This will also cause a severe... delay 
in mission execution.”
choice_data_list:
Let's use this defeat as fuel and do our 
best.
Let's throw away any naive thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Food for thought... Investigating the 
cause of defeat, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My shortcomings are—many. However, I 
must—improve—all of them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —You think I still have... naivety in me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I see... —Yet even harboring such doubt 
is proof of my naivety, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I must... refocus myself. Let us... review 
the training plan.
